title: Q-SEED-second-tenant: seed second-tenant is not a seed yet; take it to seeded (SEED-LIFECYCLE-1)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** every watchdog pass (seedlife --run)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation seedlife --probe second-tenant
**Status:** closed

SEED-LIFECYCLE-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-21): a seed is built, deployed, verified live and wired into its loops, with a design goal of 365 days unattended. A plan is not a system.

Stage: None. Next: seeded.

What the next stages need, computed from evidence:
- IDEA.md and instance.json

Gates it runs on (identity-bound, default in effect): none.

Answers live in instances/second-tenant/lifecycle.json; build the code under the paths it names, deploy through the lane (doctrine/topology.json), and close each open survival class with a probe. Never edit the claim or this item to pass.

size: L

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation seedlife --probe second-tenant` exits 0.

**Disposition:** superseded (2026-11-22): second-tenant is declared a fixture in doctrine/seed-lifecycle.json with its reason, so it is no longer judged as a seed.

**Evidence:** `python3 -m foundation seedlife --status` no longer lists second-tenant; doctrine/seed-lifecycle.json fixtures carries the reason.
